title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues: code and data
description: Code, analysis inputs and results for the pre-registered study of fabricated citations across base and post-trained language model checkpoints. Code is MIT licensed; data is CC BY 4.0 (see data/LICENSE.md). The full 900-question set is withheld to limit benchmark contamination. Many generations contain fabricated citations by design; do not use them as references.
